data.about_content:
The IGNOU Online MCA (Master of Computer Application) program is one of the most affordable options available for aspiring IT professionals. Indira Gandhi National Open University’s online MCA is a 2 year postgraduate degree program delivered through a complete virtual learning environment.

The main objective of the IGNOU Online MCA course is to assist enrolled students in building productive careers in the software industry and academia. The course includes a blend of in-depth theoretical and application-oriented courses with an emphasis on in-demand computer software development.

Students will acquire a keen understanding of the application of software technology to solve mathematical, computing, communications/networking, and commercial problems. IGNOU Online MBA covers every aspect of core computer science subjects to develop industry-ready leaders.

highlights.highlight_title: IGNOU online MCA is a 2 year course which can be completed in a maximum of 4 years.
Candidates without mathematics at the 10+2 level or at the graduation level are not eligible for the IGNOU Online MCA program.
To offer dedicated student support, IGNOU Online MCA has multiple Learner Support Centres (LSCs), administratively coordinated by the Regional Centres (RCs).
The student support services include facilities for audio-visual training aids and teleconferencing.
For self-paced learning, students are provided with self-instructional material.

data.eligibility_content:
IGNOU Online MCA applicants are eligible for the program if they successfully qualify for the following eligibility criteria and requirements:

  • BCA or an undergraduate degree in computer science engineering, or a relevant equivalent degree.

OR

  • Completed BSc/BA/BCom with mathematics at 10+2 or undergraduate level.
  • A minimum of 50% of aggregate marks at graduation is required (45% for reserved category students).

NOTE: Students with a non-relevant bachelor's degree, such as BSc/BA/BCom, are required to complete additional bridge courses, i.e., MCS-201 (Programming in C and Python) & MCS-208 (Data Structures and Algorithms).
data.admission_steps:
The detailed step-by-step IGNOU online MCA admission process is listed below: Step 1. Visit the official IGNOU Online Admission Portal and opt for the online programs.

Step 2. Click on the “Apply Now” tab and register yourself.

Step 3. After registering, start filling out the IGNOU online application form.

Step 4. Fill out your personal and professional information in the application form.

Step 5. Attach the supporting documents along with the application form.

Step 6. Pay the non-refundable application fee and submit your application form.

Step 7. Once the application is approved, the university will provide you with an admission confirmation letter.
data.syllabus_content:
The IGNOU online MCA curriculum is divided into 2 semesters per year, consisting of 4 semesters throughout the course duration. The first year courses are developed by considering the theoretical knowledge and practical skills development in core computer science subjects, whereas the second year courses focus on advanced topics equipped with a conceptual framework and project work.

data.placement_content:
To assist students in developing a successful and prominent professional career, IGNOU Online has a Campus Placement Cell (CPC). The main objective of CPC is to align every student enrolled in the IGNOU online MCA course with the right recruiter at the right place. Simultaneously, there are multiple MNCs and global business corporations partnered with IGNOU online, which recruit skilled candidates every year, some of which are mentioned below:

  • Zee Media
  • Pratham
  • Axis bank
  • Amazon
  • Doordarshan
  • TCS
